//typescript-eslint-compat: typescript-eslint@8.70.1 imports the TS compiler API directly and refuses TS 7.0 (peer-dep >=4.8.4 <6.1.0). Per the TS 7.0 migration guide (https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-7-0/#running-side-by-side-with-typescript-6.0), we alias `typescript` -> @typescript/typescript6 (the re-exported 6.0 API, so ESLint's parser works) and `@typescript/native` -> real typescript@7.0.2 (which still provides the `tsc` binary, so `npx tsc` / `npm run typecheck` / build type-check on 7.0.2). TODO: remove both aliases and restore a plain `"typescript": "7.0.2"` once typescript-eslint ships stable-API support for TS >=7.1 (tracking: https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940).
